'''Ody Mandrell's Podracer''' was a simple but speedy [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] with engines.

[[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]] used it in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. In the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|race]] of that year, one of Mandrell's [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droids]], [[DUM-4/Legends|DUM-4]], wrecked the engine by walking in front of it when Ody took a pit stop. DUM-4 was sucked in, and the engine exploded.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>
